component.name: PkHexDeck
component.summary: Pokémon save editor with a Bank, Nuzlocke and Hardcore tools

description.p: PkHexDeck is a Pokémon save file editor built for the Steam Deck. It is a fork of PKHeX-Avalonia, the Avalonia port of PKHeX, and adds a cross-game Bank, an Organizer, a Living Dex tracker, a Nuzlocke report and a Hardcore mode.
Inspect and edit Pokémon, manage boxes and party slots, check legality, and use game-specific trainer, inventory and save editors. Back up your original save before editing.
